changes: Added: you can now paste an existing FoxPro/report query and ask IntraMind to translate it into a question it can answer.
Fixed: total-sales style questions could give a different total depending on how the question was phrased, from two calculations that weren't always consistent with each other.
Fixed: a name search like "vendors named Smith and Jones" now correctly matches either name, instead of requiring both to appear together.
Fixed: folder/category filtering questions could occasionally match extra unrelated records due to a trailing-space mismatch.
Fixed: warehouse questions now consistently use the correct warehouse code instead of occasionally mixing up code and name.
Fixed: a follow-up "how does that compare to last year" question could silently reuse the wrong date range from an earlier question.
Fixed: a question about negative on-hand inventory could produce a fabricated explanation instead of just reporting the numbers.
Fixed: a P&L (profit & loss) question could report a mathematically inverted (sign-flipped) result in some phrasings.
Fixed: an AP (vendor bill) line-item amount question could double-count in some cases due to a join key mismatch.
Fixed: a per-invoice payment total could silently include allocations from a voided receipt.
Fixed: several general-ledger and year-over-year questions that previously returned no answer, or an inconsistent one, now resolve correctly.
Fixed: some questions that IntraMind could actually answer were being incorrectly refused.
Fixed: a rare SQL error on some multi-part financial summary questions (e.g. a full P&L in one answer).
Fixed: dashboard KPI drill-down could occasionally show a total that didn't match its own detail list.
Fixed: dashboard KPI drill-down no longer crashes on an unexpected server response.
Fixed: a stored-XSS issue in the KPI drill-down detail view.
Fixed: the "What's New" popup could stretch to fill the whole screen on a long changelog.
Fixed: "New Chat" could silently do nothing, and the starting suggestions could disappear permanently after your first message.
Fixed: logging out no longer leaves the previous session's dashboard/chat data briefly visible to the next login.
Fixed: a stale error or answer from a previous chat could occasionally appear after starting a new one.
Fixed: submitting feedback always showed "Thanks," even when it silently failed to send.
Fixed: several places where a slow or dropped network request could leave a button stuck disabled with no explanation, or hang indefinitely with no timeout.
Security: query rate-limiting is now based on your real originating IP instead of a value that could be spoofed.

Security: dashboard/report access now consistently enforces your module permissions everywhere, closing a couple of narrow gaps where a permission check could be skipped or accidentally treated as "allow" by default.
Security: hardened the SQL safety filter against a couple of narrow ways a disallowed statement type could have slipped through.

Fixed: dashboard AR/AP outstanding balances and overdue totals could overstate what's owed -- overpayments on a normal invoice were silently excluded from the total instead of reducing it, while an equivalent credit memo was handled correctly. Now netted consistently either way, matching a real EBMS AR Aging report exactly.
Fixed: the background service that powers AI chat answers will now automatically restart if it ever crashes, instead of silently staying down until manually restarted.
Added a Settings option to the account menu, where you can now choose to hide the SQL shown under chat answers. The theme (light/dark) toggle has also moved here from its own header button.
Query results are now shown as a scrollable table instead of typed out row-by-row, and the row limit has been raised from 200 to 1000
When a result is too large to show in full, the total count and total are now always accurate -- previously they could be silently based on only the visible rows instead of the full result
Fixed: some general ledger questions were reading an empty pending-transactions table instead of the posted ledger, which could show no activity for accounts that actually had activity
Fixed: dates stored as text in older ledger tables (including EBMS's year-end adjustment entries) no longer cause the query to fail
Fixed: questions about a specific date or period ("this month," "last week," a bare date) now resolve against today's actual date instead of an example date
Fixed: sales and revenue totals for a period are now always calculated directly in the database, never estimated from a partial list of rows
Fixed: excluding a customer or vendor by name no longer accidentally excludes every company-type account that has no first name on file
Fixed: a fuzzy-match filter (like a warehouse name) combined with a date or status filter now groups correctly, so the date/status filter can no longer be silently dropped
Fixed: item-level revenue questions no longer double-count when joined against invoice header totals
Performance: query costs reduced by caching the AI's system instructions instead of resending them in full on every question
Fixed login failing after a password reset on newer EBMS versions -- some EBMS builds store the password differently than older versions, and login now recognizes both
Auto-update now recognizes and repairs its own tunnel service if it was previously renamed or disabled by a conflict with another Cloudflare Tunnel-based product

Fixed a conflict on servers that also run other Cloudflare Tunnel-based software (e.g. Koble) -- installing or updating IntraMind could previously disable the other product's connection, and vice versa
Fixed an installation failure on servers with a newer version of Python already present
Fixed a missing dependency that could cause the installer to fail partway through on a fresh server
Vendor payment questions now correctly query vendor bills instead of customer invoices
Fixed: payments applied to a specific invoice were returning zero results due to a wrong join key between payment tables
Fixed: "bills due this week" and similar queries now correctly handle bills with no payment terms set in EBMS
Fixed: early payment discount queries now use the discount deadline, not the final payment due date
Fixed: payroll averages and counts now correctly include only finalized paychecks, not in-progress or voided entries
"Last pay period" queries now use the actual pay period from EBMS instead of an approximate date range
Fixed: job name lookups (e.g. "hours on the Riverside job") now resolve correctly through the job code
Fixed: questions asking for a count or breakdown by category now use grouped totals instead of a row list that could be truncated
Fixed: "slowest payers" and similar date-difference queries no longer error on the days calculation
Deleted/merged customer records no longer appear in customer lists and lookups
Business questions phrased in industry language (menu items, collections, payroll spend, gross margin) are now always answered directly
Ghost invoice lines from deleted EBMS records no longer appear in queries or KPI totals -- IntraMind now correctly ignores records that were deleted in EBMS but carried over by the database sync
Fixed employee hours and payroll queries where filtering by a person's name plus a date range could return results for all employees with a matching first name, ignoring the date
Item lookups by ID are now more reliable -- trailing spaces and case differences in EBMS item codes no longer cause misses
IntraMind no longer asks you to run a query yourself -- all queries run automatically and results are shown directly
All KPI dashboard cards now show a matching breakdown when clicked -- the drill-through number will always match the card
Payments received: drill-through now correctly excludes voided payments and refund rows, matching the KPI
Bills due this week: drill-through now shows only bills due within the next 7 days, not all open AP
Payroll: the KPI and drill-through now correctly exclude expense reimbursements, matching EBMS's own payroll report
Sales: drill-through now uses the same posted-invoice filter (statuses O and X) as the KPI card
Major accuracy pass on how answers are calculated -- a broad review corrected dozens of underlying data rules

Gross margin is now honest about cost data: if cost isn't recorded on most of your sales, IntraMind tells you that instead of reporting an inflated number, and explains when there are simply no tracked-item sales to measure
More reliable customer and vendor balances -- credit memos and overpayments are handled consistently, and voided payments no longer count as money received
Active/inactive filtering, payroll pay rates, job status, and quote status now match what you see in EBMS
Folder and product-line filtering is more precise (no more accidental matches from unrelated folders)
More reliable background updates
Clearer message when a margin question has no inventoried-product sales to measure -- now explains there are no tracked-item sales in the period instead of incorrectly saying there are no invoices
Major accuracy pass on how answers are calculated -- a broad review corrected dozens of underlying data rules
Gross margin is now honest about cost data: if cost isn't recorded on most of your sales, IntraMind tells you that instead of reporting an inflated number
More reliable customer and vendor balances -- credit memos and overpayments are handled consistently, and voided payments no longer count as money received
Active/inactive filtering, payroll pay rates, job status, and quote status now match what you see in EBMS
Folder and product-line filtering is more precise (no more accidental matches from unrelated folders)
Smarter answers to business questions like gross margin, most and least profitable products, and spending trends -- consistent calculations every time
Analytical answers now state how the number was calculated so you can check it against your own books
Honest about its limits -- questions it can't truly answer (like predicting churn) now point you to the closest real signal instead of guessing
Flags impossible results (like a margin over 100%) as likely data issues rather than reporting them as fact
Rate any answer with thumbs up or down -- tell us when a query gets something wrong
Failed queries are now reported automatically so we can fix them faster
Account menu button now shows a dropdown arrow so it's clearly clickable
Cleaner header -- live status, read-only note, and last-updated time consolidated into one chip
New account menu -- What's New, all updates, help and contact, and sign out in one place
What's New can now be reopened anytime from the account menu
Version number now links to the full update history
What's New dialog updated with correct brand colour and link to full update history at intramind.ca/updates
Fixed What's New not appearing on beta channel installs
Fixed folder queries returning 0 results -- items in named folders now correctly matched
Fixed What's New notification only showing for the first user to log in after an update
Fixed query errors on installs where multi-currency columns are not present
Fixed incorrect month resolution on follow-up queries
Fixed Days to Payment tile drill-down failing
Natural language folder queries now work (e.g. "items in my Parts folder")
Multi-currency awareness -- CAD and USD amounts no longer mixed in totals
Improved follow-up question context across the session
Automatic updates no longer require a GitHub token -- updates are now fully self-managing
SHA256 checksum verification on every update for integrity
What's New notifications now delivered with every update automatically
Cloudflare tunnel now automatically starts if stopped after an update
Cloudflared service configured with failure recovery — restarts automatically if it fails on boot
Log noise suppression: /health, /stats, and /logs polling no longer appears in agent.log
Portal token system: usage stats and log viewer now secured per-customer
Remote log viewer: admin portal can now pull server logs without RDP access
Usage tracking: queries today, this week, and active users visible in the admin portal
Multi-company support: switch between EBMS datasets at login (when multiple are configured)
Company name in header reflects the active dataset
Login now uses your EBMS username and password directly
Per-user permissions enforced based on your EBMS module access
Weak password warning shown after login if password doesn't meet security requirements
Initial release
Natural language queries against your EBMS database
AR, AP, inventory, payroll, job costing modules supported
